messages:
Ravi Kapoor: Heads-up: marketplace onboarding kick. Need to align AWS/GCP/Azure initial setup, legal artifacts, and packaging differences. Quick sync?
Sara Mendes: on it. I'll draft a concise onboarding checklist we can reuse across clouds.
Noah Green: I'll collect publisher console owners and billing contacts. please DM if there are special tax forms per region.
Maya Singh: I'll do packaging notes — pros/cons of single SKU vs tiered SKUs per cloud. initial thought: tiered per cloud for pricing flexibility.
Ravi Kapoor: also callout hardware partner constraints for private offers (some partners require specific AMI baselines).
legal-bot: legal note: Azure's marketplace requires explicit indemnity language in our offer; AWS/GCP rely on publisher agreement but still want privacy/data processing addendum. I'll post tailored snippets shortly.
design-bot: design will provide hero + 2 screenshots. need final copy length constraints for each marketplace.
ops-bot: ops recommends a temporary marketplace-support alias for the first 60 days to route metadata-related tickets.
Noah Green: Billing contacts: noah@redwood.ai (NA), sara@redwood.ai (EU), local tax docs in: https://drive.company/redwood/marketplace/tax-regions.zip
Maya Singh: packaging draft:
```
- Basic: RW-LITE
  features: single model, low throughput
  price: $0.04 / unit
- Standard: RW-CORE
  features: multiple models, caching
  price: $0.16 / unit
- Enterprise: RW-ENTERPRISE
  features: dedicated capacity, SLA, private deploy
  price: quote
```
Sara Mendes: I propose canonical SKU mapping doc with cloud-specific override columns. That way we keep 1 source of truth.
Ravi Kapoor: timeline: gather all assets + legal snippets by Tue EOD, submit listings Wed, dry-run publish Friday. Thoughts?
Maya Singh: works for packaging team. will create example AMI baseline notes for AWS private offers.
legal-bot: uploaded clause snippets to drive: https://drive.company/redwood/marketplace/legal/marketplace_clauses_2470.pdf
design-bot: uploaded artwork: https://drive.company/redwood/marketplace/assets/art-2470.zip
Noah Green: noted. creating checklist doc now: https://docs.company/redwood/marketplace/onboard-checklist-2470.md
Sara Mendes: tagging marketing for announcement coordination later.
Ravi Kapoor: thanks team. if any blockers ping me directly.
